[P2] Preserve exact decimals when fingerprinting expected results

The evidence reader preserves numbers such as `0.10000000000000001` as `Decimal`, including nested expected results. Standard `json.dumps` cannot serialize these values, so this branch catches `TypeError` and reports a mismatch even when the retained result, expectation, and fingerprint agree. Adding a fingerprint therefore makes otherwise valid numeric evidence fail adjudication. Use a shared Decimal-aware JSON serializer without converting through float, and add a round-trip adjudication test with matching high-precision results.
